note: Each line drawn the way the Falco archive draws one: places along a channel, generations numbered, in-marrying families as tributaries.

spines.name: Out of Carnia, for work
spines.sub: Eight generations · Gologorica to Brisbane · 1750 to 2026
spines.lede: The channel is the movement of the line. Each stop is a place it actually stood in. The names beneath a stop are the people born there; the arrows coming down are the families that married in, each bringing a town of its own.

band.label: Three generations born at the one house-number town

stops.gloss: Caroiba · the house with 1711 over the door

strands.label: The Eleven of Gračišće
strands.note: Antonio's elder brother's eleven children — New York, Buenos Aires, Tuscany, Slovenia, Croatia. Same house, proved kin, a different branch.

strands.note: Eight people of the name in the same Carnia, unworked. Same ground, no join shown.
